content_zh:
梁心铭一如三天前，还是从容不迫地走出来。
这一次，她没看见惠娘在贡院门口等她，一出来就被几个衙役给拦住了，向她确认道：“请问可是梁秀才？”
梁心铭回道：“正是在下。几位官爷有何见教？”
领头的是衙门捕头，目光沉沉地盯着梁心铭，冷冷道：“有一桩命案，请梁秀才随我们往县衙走一趟。”
梁心铭略一思忖，便点头应了。
她跟着捕头来到歙县县衙，发现惠娘和朝云竟也被带来了，当时眼神一冷，很快又恢复正常，先参见县尊大人。
县尊大人姓黄名湖，正目光炯炯地盯着她呢。
所谓“三生不幸，知县附郭”。在这徽州城内，上有知府和巡抚，黄县令这个歙县父母官实在做得辛苦极了。这不，竟赶在乡试的紧要关头出了人命案，他能不愁吗！
还好，嫌犯是个穷酸的应试秀才，连住的地方都是租来的，这让他有了些底气，遂摆出官威来严厉审问。
他喝道：“梁秀才，你可知罪？”
梁心铭从容回道：“学生不知。”
黄县令一拍惊堂木，大喝道：“你前天早晨去贡院途中，男扮女装，杀了毒老虎。还不快快招认！”
梁心铭心道：“本姑娘本来就是女人，还用装？”
面上，她却疑惑地问：“不知大人为何这样说？”
黄县令见她没被自己吓住，恼怒道：“还敢狡辩！”转而朝堂下高声吩咐：“带——豆腐西施！”
原来，毒老虎死后，他的小厮吓得魂不附体，当即去县衙报案。在公堂上，他不敢有一点隐瞒，供认说：毒老虎与豆腐西施昨天约好在渔梁街附近的巷内幽会。因为每天早上豆腐西施都要来渔梁街卖豆腐，那条巷子隐蔽，天不亮一般没人走动，所以，今早他们主仆便早早在那小巷内等候。谁知，豆腐西施来后，竟把毒老虎给杀了。
黄县令急命传豆腐西施上堂。
司马彩云吓懵了，辩称她从未和毒老虎有约，今早也根本没来渔梁街，一直在北城卖豆腐，并举了好些证人作证。
黄县令传了证人来，都证明今早买过豆腐西施的豆腐，除非她用了分身法，否则不可能跑到渔梁街来杀人。
黄县令疑惑地问道：“你天天都去渔梁街卖豆腐，怎么今天早晨不去？”

司马彩云回道：“梁秀才告诉我，说那边人多混杂，不安全。”
她并非有意攀扯梁心铭，一来这是事实；二来在她心中，梁心铭是秀才，又正考举人，是极有本事的人，和堂上的县令大人是同类人，请梁心铭作证最有说服力。
没想到，毒老虎家人趁机控告她与梁心铭勾结，谋杀毒老虎，昨天是她故意放话给毒老虎，引诱他上钩。
黄县令听说梁心铭是个俊俏少年郎，便根据丢弃在现场的丝帕、头巾和红裙子，推断梁心铭男扮女装，杀了毒老虎后，脱下女装，又从容去贡院赴考，而豆腐西施有不在现场的证据，这样谁都怀疑不到他们身上了。
为了寻找梁心铭的杀人动机，黄县令命人去城北查访，很容易就访出了豆腐西施对梁心铭有情意的传闻。
黄县令根据自己做男人的经验，觉得李惠娘虽然把夫君看得紧，奈何男人都是好*色的，恐怕梁心铭私下早与豆腐西施勾*搭成*奸了。毒老虎想霸占豆腐西施，梁心铭当然要为心上人出头谋划。
听说梁心铭很有才，考秀才时，就得了休宁县的案首。有才的人当然善于谋划，杀人也比旁人高明。要不是豆腐西施说漏了嘴，供出他来，黄县令觉得自己怕是永远也想不到他身上，也永远破获不了此案，这案子就要成为悬案！
黄县令十分得意，拈须微笑。
豆腐西施听了他推断结果，大惊失色，随即哭喊冤枉，竭力否认她和梁心铭有奸情，又说梁心铭是好人，绝不会杀人，但黄县令根本不信，命人去拿梁心铭。
梁心铭正在贡院参加乡试，拿不来，李惠娘来了。
公堂上，李惠娘比豆腐西施冷静多了，振振有词地质问道：可有人看见梁心铭男扮女装了；若无人看见，便不能确认此事是她夫君所为。
黄县令冷笑，当他是傻子吗？
证据确凿，还用人看见！
李惠娘见他不是个明察秋毫的父母官，竟不讲道理，干脆也撒泼起来，放声干嚎道：“哎哟我的老天爷呀——好人不能做呀——我夫君不过是看豆腐西施可怜，才多嘴说了一句，以前他们连话也没说过，怎么就勾搭成奸了？城北的人谁不知道豆腐西施被毒老虎欺负的事！‘捉贼拿脏、捉奸拿双’，无凭无据的，就认定他们有奸*情？青天大老爷——”

content_en:
Liang Xinming walked out calmly as he did three days ago.
This time, she didn't see Hui Niang waiting for her at the gate of Gongyuan. As soon as she came out, she was stopped by several government officials, who asked her for confirmation: "Is this Liang Xiucai?"
Liang Xinming replied: "I am exactly the same. What advice do you have from the officials?"
The leader was the yamen arrester. He stared at Liang Xinming with a heavy gaze and said coldly: "There is a murder case. Please Liang Xiucai come with us to the county yamen."
Liang Xinming thought for a moment, then nodded in agreement.
She followed the arrester to the Shexian county government office, and found that Huiniang and Chaoyun were also brought there. Her eyes turned cold at that time, but she soon returned to normal, and she first met with the county magistrate.
The county magistrate, whose surname was Huang Minghu, was staring at her with bright eyes.
The so-called "three misfortunes in life, the magistrate of the county will be attached to Guo". In Huizhou City, there are magistrates and governors. Huang County Magistrate, the parent official of She County, is really working very hard. No, there was a murder case at the critical moment of the provincial examination. How could he not worry!
Fortunately, the suspect was a poor examination scholar, and even the place he lived in was rented. This gave him some confidence, so he used his official authority to interrogate him severely.
He shouted: "Liang Xiucai, do you know your guilt?"
Liang Xinming replied calmly: "Students don't know."
Magistrate Huang was stunned and shouted: "On your way to Gongyuan the day before yesterday, you disguised yourself as a woman and killed a poisonous tiger. Why don't you confess it quickly?"
Liang Xinming thought to herself: "I am a woman originally, why do I have to pretend?"
On the face, she asked doubtfully: "I wonder why your Excellency said this?"
Seeing that she was not intimidated by him, County Magistrate Huang said angrily: "You still dare to quibble!" Then he shouted to the people in the hall: "Bring - Tofu Xishi!"
It turned out that after Poison Tiger died, his servant was so frightened that he immediately went to the county government to report the crime. In court, he did not dare to hide anything and confessed: Poison Tiger and Tofu Xishi made an appointment to have a tryst in an alley near Yuliang Street yesterday. Because Tofu Xishi comes to Yuliang Street to sell tofu every morning. That alley is hidden and no one usually walks around until dawn. Therefore, their master and servant were waiting in that alley early this morning. Unexpectedly, when Tofu Xishi came, she actually killed the poisonous tiger.
Huang County Magistrate hurriedly ordered the tofu Xishi to be brought to the court.
Sima Caiyun was frightened and argued that she had never made an appointment with Poisonous Tiger. She did not come to Yuliang Street at all this morning and had been selling tofu in Beicheng. She also cited many witnesses to testify.
Magistrate Huang summoned witnesses, and they all proved that she bought Tofu Xishi's tofu this morning. Unless she used the avatar method, it would be impossible for her to go to Yuliang Street to kill people.
Magistrate Huang asked in confusion: "You go to Yuliang Street to sell tofu every day, why didn't you go this morning?"
Sima Caiyun replied: "Liang Xiucai told me that there are many people there and it is unsafe."
She did not mean to try to seduce Liang Xinming. Firstly, this was a fact. Secondly, in her mind, Liang Xinming was a scholar, and he was taking the imperial examination. He was a very capable person, and he was the same person as the magistrate in the hall. It was most convincing to ask Liang Xinming to testify.
Unexpectedly, Du Hu's family took the opportunity to accuse her of colluding with Liang Xinming to murder Du Hu. Yesterday, she deliberately told Du Hu to lure him into taking the bait.
County Magistrate Huang heard that Liang Xinming was a handsome young man, and based on the silk handkerchief, headscarf and red skirt discarded at the scene, he inferred that Liang Xinming disguised himself as a woman, killed the poisonous tiger, took off his female clothes, and calmly went to Gongyuan to take the exam. Tofu Xishi had evidence of alibi, so no one could suspect them.
In order to find the motive for Liang Xinming's murder, Huang County ordered people to investigate in the north of the city. They easily found out the rumors that Tofu Xishi had affection for Liang Xinming.
Based on his own experience as a man, County Magistrate Huang felt that although Li Huiniang paid close attention to her husband, men were still lecherous. He was afraid that Liang Xinming had secretly hooked up with Tofu Xishi and became an adulterer. The poisonous tiger wants to occupy the tofu beauty, so of course Liang Xinming has to plan for his sweetheart.
I heard that Liang Xinming was very talented. When taking the scholar examination, he had toThe first case in Xiuning County. Talented people are certainly good at planning and killing better than others. If Tofu Xishi hadn't leaked the information and confessed to him, County Magistrate Huang felt that he would never be able to find him, and he would never be able to solve the case. This case would have become an unsolved case!
Magistrate Huang was very proud, twitching his beard and smiling.
Doufu Xishi was shocked when she heard the result of his deduction. Then she cried out that she was wronged and tried her best to deny that she and Liang Xinming had an affair. She also said that Liang Xinming was a good person and would never kill anyone. However, County Magistrate Huang did not believe it at all and ordered someone to take Liang Xinming away.
Liang Xinming was taking the provincial examination in Gongyuan, but he couldn't get it, so Li Huiniang came.
In the court, Li Huiniang was much calmer than Tofu Xishi, and asked plausibly: "Did anyone see Liang Xinming disguised as a woman? If no one saw it, it could not be confirmed that it was her husband who did it."
Magistrate Huang sneered, do you think he is a fool?
The evidence is conclusive and even seen by someone!
Seeing that he was not a perceptive parent, Li Huiniang was unreasonable, so she started acting up and howled loudly: "Oh my God - good people can't do this - my husband just said this because he was pitiful. , they didn’t even talk about it before, why did they become an adulterer? Who in the north of the city didn’t know about Tofu Xishi being bullied by the poisonous tiger! "Catch the thief to get dirty, and catch the traitor to get the double", so you think they are involved in adultery without any evidence?"
